name: status_no_target_2025
dax: EVALUATE ROW("v", INT(CALCULATE([HR KPI Status], 'HR KPI'[KPI Code]="HR_TURNOVER", 'Date'[Year]=2025) = "No target yet"))

name: actual_by_kpi_row_no_guard
dax: EVALUATE ROW("v", INT(NOT CONTAINSSTRING(CONCATENATEX(VALUES('HR KPI'[KPI Code]), [HR KPI Actual] & ""), "can't be analysed")))

name: actual_turnover_equals_bsc
dax: EVALUATE ROW("v", INT(CALCULATE([HR KPI Actual], 'HR KPI'[KPI Code] = "HR_TURNOVER", 'Date'[Year] = 2026) = CALCULATE([BSC Turnover], 'Date'[Year] = 2026)))

name: actual_headcount_2026_06
dax: EVALUATE ROW("v", CALCULATE([HR KPI Actual], 'HR KPI'[KPI Code] = "HR_HEADCOUNT", 'Date'[Year Month] = 202606))
sql: select sum(headcount) from gold.ssas_fact_headcount_monthly where month_date_key = 20260630 and is_closed_month = 'Yes' and is_contingent = 'No'

name: contingent_share_2026_06
sql: select countIf(is_contingent='Yes')/count() from gold.ssas_fact_headcount_monthly where month_date_key = 20260630

name: female_share_2026_06
sql: select countIf(gender='F' and is_contingent='No')/countIf(is_contingent='No') from gold.ssas_fact_headcount_monthly where month_date_key = 20260630

name: new_hire_turnover_2026
sql: select (select count() from gold.ssas_fact_worker_movement as m inner join gold.ssas_dim_employee as e on e.employee_key = m.employee_key where m.is_leaver = 'Yes' and m.action_date_key >= 20260101 and m.action_date_key <= toYYYYMMDD(least(toDate('2026-12-31'), today())) and e.hire_date <= toDate(toString(m.action_date_key)) and e.hire_date > addMonths(toDate(toString(m.action_date_key)), -12)) / (select count() from gold.ssas_fact_worker_movement where is_hire = 'Yes' and action_date_key > toYYYYMMDD(addMonths(least(toDate('2026-12-31'), today()), -12)) and action_date_key <= toYYYYMMDD(least(toDate('2026-12-31'), today())))

name: avg_leave_balance_2026_06
dax: EVALUATE ROW("v", CALCULATE([Average Leave Balance (days)], 'Date'[Year Month] = 202606))
sql: select sum(b) / sum(e) from (select branch_key, sum(end_balance) as b, uniqExact(employee_key) as e from gold.ssas_fact_leave_balance_monthly where is_latest_in_month = 'Yes' and is_closed_period = 'Yes' and accrual_period_date_key >= 20260601 and accrual_period_date_key < 20260701 group by branch_key)

name: status_higher_rule
dax: EVALUATE ROW("v", INT(ISEMPTY(FILTER(ADDCOLUMNS(CROSSJOIN(CALCULATETABLE(VALUES('HR KPI'[KPI Code]), 'HR KPI'[Kind] = "kpi", 'HR KPI'[Status] = "active", 'HR KPI'[Target Source] = "fixed", 'HR KPI'[Direction] = "higher"), CALCULATETABLE(VALUES('Date'[Year Month]), 'Date'[Year] = 2026)), "@a", [HR KPI Actual], "@t", [HR KPI Target], "@w", [HR KPI Watch], "@s", [HR KPI Status]), NOT ISBLANK([@a]) && NOT ISBLANK([@t]) && [@s] <> IF([@a] >= [@t], "On track", IF(NOT ISBLANK([@w]) && [@a] >= [@w], "Watch", "At risk"))))))

name: status_lower_rule
dax: EVALUATE ROW("v", INT(ISEMPTY(FILTER(ADDCOLUMNS(CROSSJOIN(CALCULATETABLE(VALUES('HR KPI'[KPI Code]), 'HR KPI'[Kind] = "kpi", 'HR KPI'[Status] = "active", 'HR KPI'[Target Source] = "fixed", 'HR KPI'[Direction] IN {"lower", "ceiling"}), CALCULATETABLE(VALUES('Date'[Year Month]), 'Date'[Year] = 2026)), "@a", [HR KPI Actual], "@t", [HR KPI Target], "@w", [HR KPI Watch], "@s", [HR KPI Status]), NOT ISBLANK([@a]) && NOT ISBLANK([@t]) && [@s] <> IF([@a] <= [@t], "On track", IF(NOT ISBLANK([@w]) && [@a] <= [@w], "Watch", "At risk"))))))

name: status_on_target_rule
dax: EVALUATE ROW("v", INT(ISEMPTY(FILTER(ADDCOLUMNS(CROSSJOIN(CALCULATETABLE(VALUES('HR KPI'[KPI Code]), 'HR KPI'[Kind] = "kpi", 'HR KPI'[Status] = "active", 'HR KPI'[Target Source] = "fixed", 'HR KPI'[Direction] = "on_target"), CALCULATETABLE(VALUES('Date'[Year Month]), 'Date'[Year] = 2026)), "@a", [HR KPI Actual], "@t", [HR KPI Target], "@w", [HR KPI Watch], "@s", [HR KPI Status]), NOT ISBLANK([@a]) && NOT ISBLANK([@t]) && [@s] <> IF(ISBLANK([@w]), IF([@a] = [@t], "On track", "At risk"), IF(ABS([@a] - [@t]) <= ABS([@w] - [@t]) / 2, "On track", IF(ABS([@a] - [@t]) <= ABS([@w] - [@t]), "Watch", "At risk")))))))

name: status_bsc_source_equals_bsc_status_2026
dax: EVALUATE ROW("v", INT(NOT ISBLANK(CALCULATE([BSC Status], 'BSC KPI'[KPI Code] = "LRN_REVENUE_PER_FTE", 'Date'[Year] = 2026)) && CALCULATE([HR KPI Status], 'HR KPI'[KPI Code] = "HR_REVENUE_PER_FTE", 'Date'[Year] = 2026) = CALCULATE([BSC Status], 'BSC KPI'[KPI Code] = "LRN_REVENUE_PER_FTE", 'Date'[Year] = 2026)))

name: status_text_colour_bsc_source_2026
dax: EVALUATE ROW("v", INT(CALCULATE([HR KPI Status Text], 'HR KPI'[KPI Code] = "HR_REVENUE_PER_FTE", 'Date'[Year] = 2026) = SWITCH(CALCULATE([BSC Status], 'BSC KPI'[KPI Code] = "LRN_REVENUE_PER_FTE", 'Date'[Year] = 2026), "On track", "● On track", "Watch", "◆ Watch", "At risk", "■ At risk") && CALCULATE([HR KPI Status Colour], 'HR KPI'[KPI Code] = "HR_REVENUE_PER_FTE", 'Date'[Year] = 2026) = SWITCH(CALCULATE([BSC Status], 'BSC KPI'[KPI Code] = "LRN_REVENUE_PER_FTE", 'Date'[Year] = 2026), "On track", "#0E9F8E", "Watch", "#EF8B00", "At risk", "#DB280A")))

name: status_no_data_headcount_2025

name: status_text_colour_no_target_2025
dax: EVALUATE ROW("v", INT(CALCULATE([HR KPI Status Text], 'HR KPI'[KPI Code] = "HR_TURNOVER", 'Date'[Year] = 2025) = "○ No target yet" && CALCULATE([HR KPI Status Colour], 'HR KPI'[KPI Code] = "HR_TURNOVER", 'Date'[Year] = 2025) = "#9AA7B5"))

name: status_blank_for_a_metric_row
dax: EVALUATE ROW("v", INT(ISBLANK(CALCULATE([HR KPI Status], 'HR KPI'[KPI Code] = "HR_M_FTE", 'Date'[Year] = 2026))))

name: target_not_set_2025
dax: EVALUATE ROW("v", INT(CALCULATE([HR KPI Target Text], 'HR KPI'[KPI Code] = "HR_TURNOVER", 'Date'[Year] = 2025) = "Not set" && ISBLANK(CALCULATE([HR KPI Target], 'HR KPI'[KPI Code] = "HR_TURNOVER", 'Date'[Year] = 2025)) && ISBLANK(CALCULATE([HR KPI Watch], 'HR KPI'[KPI Code] = "HR_TURNOVER", 'Date'[Year] = 2025)) && ISBLANK(CALCULATE([HR KPI Fixed Target], 'HR KPI'[KPI Code] = "HR_TURNOVER", 'Date'[Year] = 2025)) && ISBLANK(CALCULATE([HR KPI Fixed Watch], 'HR KPI'[KPI Code] = "HR_TURNOVER", 'Date'[Year] = 2025)) && CALCULATE([HR KPI Is Placeholder], 'HR KPI'[KPI Code] = "HR_TURNOVER", 'Date'[Year] = 2025) = 0))

name: target_bsc_source_equals_bsc_target_2026
dax: EVALUATE ROW("v", INT(ABS(CALCULATE([HR KPI Target], 'HR KPI'[KPI Code] = "HR_REVENUE_PER_FTE", 'Date'[Year] = 2026) - CALCULATE([BSC Target], 'BSC KPI'[KPI Code] = "LRN_REVENUE_PER_FTE", 'Date'[Year] = 2026)) < 0.01 && CALCULATE([HR KPI Target Text], 'HR KPI'[KPI Code] = "HR_REVENUE_PER_FTE", 'Date'[Year] = 2026) = FORMAT(CALCULATE([BSC Target], 'BSC KPI'[KPI Code] = "LRN_REVENUE_PER_FTE", 'Date'[Year] = 2026), "#,0")))
